source: sars-guide:SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G05 Guide for Employers in respect of Employment Tax Incentive, Revision 17 s14 p. 9 (opening balances for 1 March start at zero)
notes: February 2027: ETI R5 000 and no employees tax, so R5 000 is refund claimable at the end of the reconciliation period. March 2027: ETI nil, employees tax R1 000. s14 p. 9: the excess is ring-fenced and the opening balance for 1 March always starts at zero, so March uses none of it. Range February-March: brought forward nil, used nil (March has R1 000 tax but nothing available), carried forward nil, refund 5 000.
